OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time. The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_TENANT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID of the app registration.

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_CLIENT_ID.description: Client (application) ID of the app registration.

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the app registration.

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_LOGIN_URL.description: Microsoft Entra ID login URL: 'https://login.microsoftonline.com' (global and US Government L4) or 'https://login.microsoftonline.us' (US Government L5, DoD).

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_GRAPH_URL.description: Microsoft Graph URL: 'https://graph.microsoft.com' (global), 'https://graph.microsoft.us' (US Government L4) or 'https://dod-graph.microsoft.us' (US Government L5, DoD).

MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_HUNT_SIGMA_PIPELINE.description: pySigma pipeline translating Sigma rules: 'microsoft_xdr' (Defender XDR advanced hunting tables) or 'none'.
